item.text: The affected code is in `packages/utils/src/postmortem.ts`; the existing subprocess fixture already verifies deadline diagnostics. I’ll clamp the parsed value at Node/Bun’s maximum timer delay (`2_147_483_647`) and extend that contract test to cover an overflowing environment value.

The regression test exposed an important test-harness issue: a correctly clamped deadline is intentionally ~24.8 days, so the subprocess test cannot wait for the real timer. I’m adjusting only the fixture to make its timer fire immediately while still asserting the deadline value passed through the production path.
